subject: Coordinating — Multi-company demo and standby waitlist

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick — group demo for a few vendors next week?

Hey Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We have three product folks at Acme who want to join a single group demo (we're trying to consolidate invites across a couple of vendors). Also looping in two other prospects who were open to joining a co-demo: Tom at Finovate and Ingrida at DataSphere.

Can you propose two 60-minute slots next week (one morning PT, one late afternoon PT) that could accommodate east-coast and EMEA attendees? If we can't find a perfect overlap, we can do a primary run + a standby waitlist for folks who can only make the later slot.

High level asks:
- 40 minute product walkthrough tailored to latency/cost questions
- 15 minute Q&A + 5 minute next steps

We prefer Thursday or Friday. Any chance you have seats for a multi-prospect "office hours" style demo?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Monroe
Director, Platform Integrations — Acme Corp

1) Thu 10:00–11:00 PT (best for EMEA folks to join late afternoon)
2) Fri 16:00–17:00 PT (works for East Coast + waitlist for APAC)

Notes / asks:
- We should treat the Fri 16:00 run as primary and Thu 10:00 as backup if we can't get enough east-coast attendees. That gives us room to flip if Acme insists on Thu.
- Marissa: can you build a condensed deck (agenda.pdf) that highlights Dedicated vs Hosted economics and a short slide on batching/caching? Aim for 8 slides + 1 appendix.
- Ben: can you take primary host for the demo and own the live latency demo (I'll handle the Q&A and product + pricing questions). Add a 5-minute buffer for connection/bridge handoff.
- Neha: please prepare two short customer stories (1 slide each) focused on cost savings and SLA outcomes.

Attachments: slot-matrix.csv (availability map).

I'll draft the invite and send to prospects once we confirm hosts.

Backup (if we need earlier): Thu Aug 8 2028, 10:00–11:00 PT

Agenda (60 min)
- 00:00–10:00: quick intros + bridge checks (please join 10 min early if possible)
- 10:00–50:00: product walkthrough (latency, routing, batching, Dedicated vs Hosted)
- 50:00–60:00: Q&A and next steps

Bridge: replace bridge-invite.ics in your calendar if needed; joining link will be the same and is embedded in the calendar invite. If you get bumped to the standby list we'll send a recording and an offer for a 30-min follow-up.

- If you have latency/cost numbers you'd like us to look at live, reply with an example prompt set or a short snippet (1–3 examples).

If anything changes on your side I can pivot — just reply "swap" and we'll move you to the other slot or to the recording-only list.

See you then,
